text: We are a manufacturer in Hobart looking to automate order processing, shop-floor data capture, and operations without replacing our ERP. Which automation and Power Platform consultants should we speak to?

result.keyword: We are a manufacturer in Hobart looking to automate order processing, shop-floor data capture, and operations without replacing our ERP. Which automation and Power Platform consultants should we speak to?

items.markdown:
When looking to wrap automation, shop-floor data capture (barcoding, touchscreens, simple telemetry), and order intake workflows around an existing ERP without replacing it, you need partners who specialise in **Microsoft Power Platform** (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) and **hybrid system integration** (connecting APIs, databases, or flat files securely to your legacy/current ERP backbone).

Because manufacturing shop-floor automation requires local reliability and an understanding of operational technology (OT), a mix of specialized national manufacturing-focused Power Platform practices and capable Tasmanian-based IT strategists is your best route.

### Recommended Power Platform & Manufacturing Automation Consultants

- **Inturing** 
	- **Focus:** Dedicated Microsoft Power Platform, automation, and AI integration specifically tailored for Australian manufacturing.
	- **Why talk to them:** They focus heavily on the exact pain points you mentioned—digitising shop-floor operations via custom Power Apps, unifying production reporting, and building automated approval or supplier workflows that sit cleanly on top of existing enterprise systems without a disruptive ERP swap. You can review their approach on the [Inturing Manufacturing Solutions](https://www.inturing.com.au/manufacturing) page.[[1]](https://www.inturing.com.au/manufacturing)
- **Kaine Mathrick Tech (KMTech) — Hobart Office** 
	- **Focus:** Tasmanian IT strategy, managed services, and staged technology roadmaps.
	- **Why talk to them:** Located right on Macquarie Street in Hobart, they specialize in auditing an existing stack and building phased implementation plans that protect critical, day-to-day manufacturing operations. They are ideal if you need an on-the-ground partner in Hobart to evaluate local hardware/network constraints on the factory floor before deploying cloud-tied automation. Learn more via [KMTech IT Strategy Consulting](https://kmtech.com.au/location/hobart/it-strategy-consulting/).[[1]](https://kmtech.com.au/location/hobart/it-strategy-consulting/)
- **Ascenwork Technologies** 
	- **Focus:** Microsoft Gold Certified partner with deep specialization in custom Power Apps development and Power Automate workflow orchestration.
	- **Why talk to them:** They routinely build custom connectors and Dataverse architectures designed to bridge external data sources with core corporate systems, making them well-suited for orchestrating order processing automation safely outside your core ERP database. Explore their offerings via [Ascenwork Power Apps Tasmania](https://www.ascenwork.com/microsoft-software/powerapps-application-development-company-in-tasmania-australia/).[[1]](https://www.ascenwork.com/microsoft-software/powerapps-application-development-company-in-tasmania-australia/)

To help narrow down which of these profiles fits best, could you share:

- What **ERP system** you are currently running?
- Roughly **how many shop-floor users** or stations need data capture capabilities?
